gaps.sentence: Their ___ (FRIEND) goes back to their university days.
gaps.explanation: 'Friendship' is the relationship between friends; 'friendliness' is a manner.

gaps.sentence: The vaccine gives ___ (PROTECT) against three strains.
gaps.explanation: 'Gives protection against' — the noun is required.
'Her confidence' — the noun; 'confident' is the adjective.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (IMPORTANT) of sleep is often ignored.
The closure of the mine will leave four hundred workers ___ (EMPLOY).
gaps.explanation: 'Leave somebody unemployed' — the negative adjective describes the workers.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ (ABLE) to attend because of illness.
gaps.explanation: 'Unable to attend' — negative of able is unable.
'Championship victory' — the title/contest, not the person.
